project_title: AI SME Digital Growth Advisor (Cradilot AI)
tagline: Helping SMEs Discover Their Next Digital Step
market_context: Over 95% of Malaysian businesses are SMEs. Many purchase wrong tools, waste capital, implement in wrong sequence, and fail to realize ROI.

step_1_business_discovery.bonus: AI dynamically asks follow-up questions tailored to the enterprise context.

step_3_ai_readiness_score.hard_lock_defense: If DMS < 40, ARS must be locked below 10 to prevent premature selling of advanced AI to fragile infrastructure.

step_4_business_pain_points.mandate: Evidence-based analysis rather than generic boilerplate.
top_5_standard_cases: Too much manual work (paper orders, double-entry)
No CRM (customer data siloed on employee personal phones)
Customer enquiries handled manually (late night and weekend inquiry loss)
Marketing not measurable (dormant site without GA4/Pixel tracking)
No internal knowledge management (single PC accounting data vulnerability)

business_email.why: Free email has 35%+ spam filter discard rate, zero MACC 17A legal audit trail. Domain email ensures 99.8% delivery and compliance.

website.why: Managed WordPress AI gives B2B SMEs high SEO ranking and NVMe speed for RM 43.99/mo, avoiding RM 10,000+ custom development cost.

cloud_backup.why: Guarantees RTO < 30 minutes, AES-256 offsite encryption, protects against PDPA RM 500k fines.

financial_model_benchmarks.malaysia_labor_cost_standard: Average salary RM 3,000/mo + EPF/SOCSO = RM 3,500/mo total cost -> RM 22.00 / hour standard rate.
financial_model_benchmarks.benchmark_roi: 505% first-year ROI (RM 28,000+ net gain on RM 5,550 package)

sales_tool_integration.action: On 'Free Consultation' click, generate SalesLead payload with pre-configured cart and 3-stage icebreaker talk track.
